## What's new

- PlayStation, on PCSX-ReARMed built for the Brick: a PlayStation shelf for Roms/PlayStation (.chd, .cue, .pbp, .iso, .img, .m3u), with the CRT shaders, overlays, cheats, save states and button mapping. No BIOS needed; a real one in Bios/ is used when it's there.
- Achievements for PlayStation games, matched the way RetroAchievements identifies a disc.
- Games on more than one disc: a folder with an .m3u is one game. MENU > Disc in the game: Swap Disc when the game asks for the next one, or Restart With This Disc to start from it.
- A tidier main menu: Wi-Fi & Bluetooth and System Settings (sound, Date & Time, Show Clock, Show Battery, Auto Off) on pages of their own, and a dot on Updates when a new ChaOS is waiting, which can be turned off.
- Shader opens its page, where it's switched on and off.
- Logs are named chaos.log.

---

ChaOS 2.4.0 for the TrimUI Brick and Brick Hammer.

**Install or update** with [ChaOS Installer](https://github.com/SkyWalker541/ChaOS-Installer/releases/latest), or write `ChaOS-v2.4.0-brick.img.xz` to a card yourself (that erases it).

ChaOS is built on [TortOS 2.2.0](https://github.com/ericreinsmidt/TortOS/releases/tag/v2.2.0) by Eric Reinsmidt. `ChaOS-v2.4.0-brick-sources.tar` is the source of everything in the image; what came from where is in [CREDITS.md](https://github.com/SkyWalker541/ChaOS/blob/main/CREDITS.md).
